notes.title: Better Graphics & Visuals!
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

We are always looking for ways to improve the quality of Blood Raiders. This time we'd like to inform you about noticeable visual improvements that make the game look so much better now.

First, we've enhanced 3D maps of the game by adding more objects, like ancient ruins, altars, stones, statues, etc. More light sources are placed strategically for a more cinematic look on maps. And we've added shadows with higher resolution as well.
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sMkCxAH.gif[/img]
 
More detailed 3D character models for the main protagonist, enemies, and NPC are also part of the game now. They all have better movement animations, textures, and materials. With this update, we've moved from a chibi-like style to a semi-realistic one, which better matches the artistic vision of the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8snUqy8.gif[/img]

2D art has been greatly improved to make all characters, NPC and enemies on par with improved 3D style. All character sprites for dialogues and scenes have been enhanced. They not only look better, but also have a wider set of facial expressions to be used during interactions.  Your friends and enemies have never looked better!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GVF6Hm9.png[/img]

And of course, we've invested a lot of time into remaking all explicit and hardcore scenes of the game. Hot babes look stunningly beautiful during all kinds of sex scenes, and you can almost feel how wet and horny they are.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BpZCCTi.jpeg[/img]

Dear friends, we're happy to work on such a great game, and can't wait to deliver a Steam demo for you to enjoy. Stay tuned!

[h3][b]⭐Add Blood Raiders to your wishlist! [/b]

[b]⭐Join our Discord for even more news, screenshots, and gifts![/b][/h3]
